description: This Java class implements a service for reading client family members data from a database, including methods to retrieve individual or multiple family members and template data for dropdown options.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for reading client family members data from the database.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation to map SQL result set to ClientFamilyMembersData objects.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of family members for a specific client ID.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMember
methods.description: Retrieves a single family member by their unique ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides template data for dropdown options such as marital status, gender, relationship, and profession.
